verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports config-as-code versioning via Terraform provider and API-driven management (airbyte-docs-2, airbyte-docs-19, airbyte-docs-3), and the Connection Timeline provides a history/review view of connection events including errors (airbyte-docs-10, airbyte-docs-57). However, there is no evidence of native rollback of automations/connections, no version history UI for connection configs themselves, and no built-in review/approval workflow — these rely on external tooling (Terraform/git) rather than a first-party review-and-rollback feature. missing for 10: native rollback mechanism for syncs/connections, in-product version history/diff of connection configs, built-in approval/review workflow, independent evidence of these working in practice.
